name: OsamaSon
description: '''Amari Deshawn Adham Middleton''' (born May 20, 2003), known professionally as '''OsamaSon''', is an American [[rapper]], [[songwriter]] and [[record producer]]. A member of the [[2020s underground rap]] scene, he rose to prominence with his singles "Cts-V" and "Troops", which gained traction online in early 2023. That same year, he released his debut mixtape, ''Osama Season'', and his debut studio album, ''Flex Musix''. In 2025, he released two studio albums, ''[[Jump Out]]'' and ''[[Psykotic]]'', both of which entered the [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]].
